description: Scenario corpus for the VRF exposure pipeline parity machine. Consumed by the Python reference model, the C# timeline emitter, and any engine oracle capture driver.

scenarios.name: constant_dark
scenarios.description: Steady dark scene; the chain should converge to the max clamp and stay there.

scenarios.name: constant_bright
scenarios.description: Steady bright scene; the chain should converge to the min clamp and stay there.

scenarios.name: dark_to_bright
scenarios.description: Step from a dark to a bright scene at frame 12; exercises the downward branch.

scenarios.name: bright_to_dark
scenarios.description: Step from a bright to a dark scene at frame 12; exercises the upward branch.

scenarios.name: clamp_max
scenarios.description: Raw scalar far above ExposureMax on every frame.

scenarios.name: clamp_min
scenarios.description: Raw scalar far below ExposureMin on every frame.

scenarios.name: warmup_history_boundary
scenarios.description: Monotonically rising raw scalar across the frame 9 -> frame 10 window switch.

scenarios.name: history_ripple
scenarios.description: Alternating raw scalar; exposes how much the inverted window lags the newest sample.

scenarios.name: speed_up_zero
scenarios.description: ExposureSpeedUp of zero takes the snap branch in both directions.

scenarios.name: speed_down_zero
scenarios.description: ExposureSpeedDown of zero; the negated zero rate reaches the overshoot guard.

scenarios.name: asymmetric_speeds
scenarios.description: Fast up, slow down, smoothing disabled so the configured rates apply directly.

scenarios.name: smoothing_engaged
scenarios.description: Default smoothing range; the rate is halved log-distance, not the configured speed.

scenarios.name: smoothing_disabled
scenarios.description: Same trajectory with smoothing off, as the control for `smoothing_engaged`.

scenarios.name: compensation_one_stop
scenarios.description: One stop of exposure compensation; adaptation state must be unaffected.

scenarios.name: compensation_negative
scenarios.description: Minus one stop of compensation, as the mirror of `compensation_one_stop`.

scenarios.name: exposure_bias
scenarios.description: Tonemap exposure bias, applied in the shader rather than the adaptation chain.

scenarios.name: variable_delta_time
scenarios.description: Irregular frame pacing including a long hitch; integration is linear in log2 space.

scenarios.name: zero_delta_time_down
scenarios.description: A zero-length frame while adapting downward.

scenarios.name: zero_delta_time_up
scenarios.description: A zero-length frame while adapting upward, as the control for the downward case.

scenarios.name: non_finite_luminance
scenarios.description: Average luminance of zero on frames 6 and 7 makes the raw scalar infinite.

scenarios.name: auto_exposure_toggle
scenarios.description: Auto exposure disabled for frames 6-11 and re-enabled afterwards.

scenarios.name: long_convergence
scenarios.description: Sixty frames of steady input; the tail must be stationary to machine precision.
